title: Renderer architecture: one content schema, swappable renderers

comments.author: home
comments.text:
=== ORCHESTRATOR HANDOFF - 2026-09-06, written expecting imminent rate-limit cutoff ===
=== IF YOU ARE PICKING UP COLD, THIS IS THE ENTRY POINT. ===

THE GOAL: a working proof of concept that ACTUALLY PUBLISHES ACTUAL PAGES. Not a design doc, not a stub. Ryan chose a MAXIMALIST rearchitecture explicitly: do not avoid big changes for expediency, and it is acceptable to go back and fix existing Papyrus and Threat Intelligence content.

THE THESIS, PROVEN NOT ASSUMED:
Markus's directive vocabulary IS the Papyrus content schema. Papyrus Article.body is string[] (flat plain-text paragraphs) with pullQuotes[] as a side-channel array having NO position in the prose. Markus's vocabulary is a strict superset AND positional. So: one Markdown source, two renderers. Markus renders at full fidelity; Pretext consumes a LOSSY PROJECTION. I verified this end to end against the real IR - the working algorithm and its output are in PPY-a10206.
DEGRADATION RULE, NON-NEGOTIABLE: any directive Pretext cannot express recurses into its children so content is preserved inline. NOTHING is ever silently dropped.

NOMENCLATURE - DECIDED BY RYAN, DO NOT RELITIGATE:
Renderer (pretext|markus) x Layout (newsprint|blog|magazine, Pretext-internal) x Publication (the title/property).
BANNED: publisher, publication type, front end, press, site type.

STATE OF THE WORLD:
- Papyrus /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus branch feature/renderer-architecture. Built ON TOP of PR #57's head.
- Markus /Users/home/Projects/Markus branch feature/document-ir. Pip-installed editable, so 'markus' on PATH runs that tree.
- NOTHING IS PUSHED anywhere. Neither branch exists on origin. Ryan endorsed working DIRECTLY in AnthusAI/Papyrus - not a fork - but has NOT authorized any push. Do not push without him saying so.
- CROSS-REPO HAZARD: Papyrus depends on the UNPUSHED Markus branch. Another machine will not have it.

DONE AND REVIEWED:
- kanbus-37dd9a: Markus typed document IR (schema_version 1). Block nodes and directives as ordered peers, typed inline nodes. Inline code spans are 'code_span', distinct from block 'code'.
- kanbus-dacb70: front-matter date/datetime serialize to ISO 8601; unrepresentable types raise a named error instead of a silent fallback.
- kanbus-2ecaf7: bare HH:MM:SS no longer silently becomes int 48600 (PyYAML YAML-1.1 sexagesimal). Fixed surgically; octal/hex/bool/date all verified unchanged.
- PPY-d79ff2: Renderer interface + Pretext retrofitted onto it (commit f9b073f). lib/publisher.ts DELETED. Five call sites go THROUGH the interface. lint + typecheck clean.

RUNNING RIGHT NOW (do not duplicate, avoid these files):
- PPY-a10206 + PPY-88f77b: IR ingestion, Pretext projection, Markus renderer, REAL PUBLISHED PAGES. Touches lib/, renderers/. THIS IS THE CRITICAL PATH.
- PPY-6b4094: AWS deployment + real baseline. Touches amplify/, docs/.
- PPY-61dc8f: reader-settings newspaper->newsprint alias (Haiku). Touches amplify/functions/reader-settings/.
- PPY-5e8072: Pilobil.us visual design. Touches /Users/home/Projects/Pilobol.us + Markus CSS.

READY QUEUE + MODEL GUIDANCE: see PPY-da6f1f.

TWO ENVIRONMENT FACTS THAT WILL WASTE YOUR TIME IF YOU DO NOT KNOW THEM:
1. 'npm run build' FAILS at 'Collecting page data' (TypeError: Cannot convert undefined or null to object). This is IDENTICAL on origin/develop. PRE-EXISTING and environmental - no reachable AppSync backend. Do not chase it; PPY-6b4094 owns it.
2. BDD: 117 scenarios, ~39 failed, 27 undefined. Two pre-existing causes - operator-cli.feature has zero cucumber-js step definitions (it targets behave), and console scenarios have no seeded data. PPY-fd8468 owns it, deliberately HELD until 6b4094 reports.
Also: typecheck passes partly because a synthetic gitignored amplify_outputs.json exists locally. Do not read 'typecheck clean' as evidence the Amplify wiring is healthy.

WORKING STANDARD, LEARNED THE HARD WAY: do not accept subagent reports at face value - re-run their checks. Three of four reports so far contained an undisclosed inaccuracy (a silent package-version downgrade 0.4.0->0.1.0; a diff claimed to cover '8 files' in directories holding 4; an unreachable code path claimed as handled). All were caught only by re-running. Check 'git diff --stat' for files the task had no business touching.

WHAT #57 GOT WRONG - do not revert toward it: metadata-only registry with no operations; requiresPretext baking an implementation name into a generic interface; dispatch inside a React component forcing a build-time renderer through a runtime path; required-but-ignored config; and the false claim that 'markus validate' makes fragments safe to mount (it validates vocabulary, not XSS).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Ryan: static Amplify WEB is a Papyrus hosting *option*, not a Pilobil fork. Hosting is a sibling axis of Renderer × Layout × Publication. PPY-17fcfc retitled and moved under PPY-92f846. Anti-pattern: a per-publication Papyrus GitHub repo (the Threat Intelligence Amplify app). Docs belong in Papyrus.
